text: Implemented platform-aware deterministic ordered frame mapping: JVM uses a bounded fixed thread pool preserving input order; Scala.js exposes ParallelFrames as UnsupportedControl. The estimator maps independent final-diagnostic and template-refresh frame work through the scheduler while leaving warm-start fitting deterministic. Added scheduler order, nThreads, sequential-vs-parallel equality, and platform-boundary tests. Verified motionJVM/test, motionJS/test, compileAll, and narrow git diff --check.
